title: Minimax Wasserstein Risk over Observationally Equivalent Proxy Representations at a Homogeneous Collision
banked_reason: D0.5 terminal:below-floor: achieved incremental below field; paper_score_ceiling 6.1 < 7.4. Global certified fiber value, effective tail modulus, and expanding-neighborhood observed-sample attainment remain open; finite-game gap not derived.
gap_reasons: The certified constants establish a strict separation between the residual Gaussian fiber game and its representation-known oracle, but they do not establish that separation for the original observed-sample minimax criterion.
The note also provides no global numerical bracket for C_fib, no actual fixed-compact numerical certificate, and no data-only estimator attaining the full game on expanding neighborhoods.

The cited finite-menu lemma yields an epsilon-minimax decision mixture, but the proof does not derive the asserted finite dual value d_{rho,N} or p_{rho,N}-d_{rho,N}<=tau_N; add finite zero-sum/LP duality or a proved primal-dual mirror-descent certificate before using (14)-(15).
proof_attempt_summary: Discovery constructed the legal observational representation fiber, the profiled Gaussian shape game, and a strict Gaussian lower bound above every representation-known oracle bound. It attempted a globally certified sharp value and transfer to one observed-data estimator, but the effective tail modulus and expanding-radius control were not proved. The fixed-compact finite-game dual gap also remains unproved, so its asserted certificate must be repaired before reuse.
tldr: At a homogeneous two-class proxy collision inside the Virk--Mazaheri--Wu proxy class, a continuum of latent representations produces one observed law but different local effect-law weights and information. The project proves the exact Hunt--Stein reduction to a six-dimensional Gaussian shape game and a strict representation-adaptation premium: the common-representation minimax risk exceeds the largest representation-known oracle risk by more than \(1.5155\) and by a factor greater than \(1.98\). It also proves a safe-truncated compact/tail patching bound and the non-effective limit identity \(C_{\mathrm{fib}}=\lim_{\rho\to\infty}\max\{V_\rho,C_{\mathrm{tail}}^*\}\), certifies every fully checked fixed compact game along a schedule on which all six error moduli vanish, and transfers bounded quantized rules and design-score-balanced finite-prior lower bounds at fixed local radius. An effective stratified tail modulus, an arbitrary-tolerance global certificate, an attained analytic saddle, and an explicit expanding-neighborhood attaining estimator remain open.
gap: Virk, Mazaheri, and Wu recover separated latent effects and weights, while the accepted collision paper establishes collision-uniform root-\(n\) Wasserstein rates. Neither result solves one local decision problem uniformly over a continuum of observationally equivalent proxy representations. Existing Gaussian decision results address treatment choice, point decisions, or weak moment models, not probability-measure decisions under atomic Wasserstein loss with representation-dependent masses.
fill: The project identifies the exact Gaussian minimax value by an exact invariant reduction, observable-mean compact games, and an operational stratified tail limit that includes collision transitions. It proves a strict oracle gap by an exact regular-at-infinity lower subexperiment and a rational interval oracle bound, then establishes equality with the iterated local asymptotic minimax risk in the original sixteen-cell experiment.
